title: Rustbound Legacy
description: Build modular space stations, run industrial colonies, and explore 71 worlds across six star systems.
controls: Keyboard & mouse · H journal · M map · optional flight school
choiceQuote: The sequel to Rustbound. Some of the site's best. Colonize, fly, and walk in full 3D.
The Rooms Between is a sci-fi horror adventure. Procedurally generated, every time you play is new.
title: The Rooms Between
description: An impossible place. Endless rooms. Find supplies, find shelter, find a way through.

title: Switchyard
description: Four railway yards. Three quick shifts. Route your trains, earn medals, and keep the crossings clear.
choiceQuote: A quick, fun arcade game about bringing trains to stations.
controls: Tap / click · 1, 2, 3 to switch · S to slow

title: Stardust Foundry
description: Harvest stardust, buy an automated fleet, and grow an interstellar industry.

title: Frontier
description: Establish a colony, manage its resources, and work toward an orbital launch.

title: Squircle Siege
description: Build your defenses and protect the route from waves of squircles.

title: Afterimage
description: Record your movements, leave an echo on a switch, and solve six rooms alongside yourself.
controls: WASD / arrows · Space record · C clear echoes

title: Midnight Kitchen
description: A two-minute cooking rush. Prep, cook, and serve three dishes while the orders stack up.

title: Laserline
description: Turn mirrors and carry a single beam through every receiver. Six hand-built light puzzles, with undo and no time limit.
controls: Click mirrors · arrows select · Space rotates · Z undo

title: Bridgewright
description: Design a bridge, run a loaded truck across it, and watch every beam bend. Build lighter, stronger trusses across eight crossings.
controls: Click joints to connect · click empty grid to add a joint · Test bridge

title: Cloudkeeper
description: Move the clouds. Time the rain. Keep a tiny hillside garden alive through changing winds without drowning it.
controls: Drag clouds · click Rain or hold Space · harvest automatically

title: Starball
description: A compact cosmic pinball table with physical flippers, lively bumpers, lit lanes and a hungry drain. Three balls. Chase your best.
controls: A / D or arrows: flippers · Space launch · N nudge
